scope: Spline kinematic-sampling sub_y_5, 3D BC_RC_Bayesian only, on a copy of alternatives/spline/sub_y_5/histograms.root. Q2-y 1-17, 452 histograms. Bayesian, RC_Bayesian, Bin, and 5D are absent and were not created. No publication. The source ROOT file, budgets, sector exclusions, histogram weights, and the shared Phi_h guides were not edited. The destination did not already contain refinement_note.json and fit.json, so this is not a resume.
start_mode: spline. start=auto: the BC_RC keys these 452 histograms select have median B width 0.17 and only 5 are narrower than 0.05, and the C median width is 0.10 with 10 narrower than 0.05, so those windows are not tight. The run-local guide started as Prepare_Next_Iteration/Phi_h_Fit_Parameters_from_Spline.py. --use_spline_init was not passed.
changed: Pass 1 refit all 452 histograms with the run-local copy of the universal spline file and the corrected filled-window range. 450 selected spline keys match the manual keys that made the stored fit, so those histograms did not move. (Q2_y_Bin_15)-(z_pT_Bin_24) is the spline 3D-BC key rather than the tighter manual BC key, and that pass lowered its chi-squared ((Q2_y_Bin_15)-(z_pT_Bin_24) 43.160 to 38.014). (Q2_y_Bin_9)-(z_pT_Bin_32) already sat inside the wider spline window and did not move. Pass 2 opened only the histograms whose own cosine was outside the guide or was stuck in the rough-start window, including the legacy (1, 8) and (1, 9) BC limits. It did not copy nominal parameters. JSON still has 452 bins. 30 histograms have a lower chi-squared than the stored fit and none is higher by more than 0.05. Largest drops: (Q2_y_Bin_13)-(z_pT_Bin_4) 147.305 to 30.686; (Q2_y_Bin_3)-(z_pT_Bin_29) 54.636 to 28.461; (Q2_y_Bin_15)-(z_pT_Bin_15) 49.251 to 23.952; (Q2_y_Bin_14)-(z_pT_Bin_5) 57.408 to 36.465; (Q2_y_Bin_3)-(z_pT_Bin_16) 29.772 to 9.894; (Q2_y_Bin_10)-(z_pT_Bin_11) 28.099 to 16.154; (Q2_y_Bin_4)-(z_pT_Bin_33) 14.534 to 5.031; (Q2_y_Bin_11)-(z_pT_Bin_20) 46.139 to 37.651. (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_8) was stored at the second-pass edge B=-0.045 from the legacy BC limits [-0.03, 0.05] and C [0, 0.1]. It is kept at B=-0.120966, statistical error 0.044456, C=-0.053871, error 0.039433, chi-squared 20.638, NDF 13.0, phi 60-300, 16 histogram bins inside the TF1 range. That is this histogram's cosine, not the nominal BC B=-0.116016 and not the acceptance B=-0.125191.
left_bins: No 5D family is in this file, so nothing was left from a 3D-versus-5D disagreement. Large nominal-minus-variation shifts that already match this histogram were not moved: (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_7) B=-0.251965 versus nominal -0.329563, shift +0.077598, cosine chi-squared left 0.000; (Q2_y_Bin_6)-(z_pT_Bin_6) B=-0.275704 versus nominal -0.347901, shift +0.072197, cosine chi-squared left 0.000; (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_22) B=0.004465 versus nominal -0.044242, shift +0.048707, cosine chi-squared left 0.000. Collapsed parameter errors that remain are a stability note, not a smaller systematic uncertainty, and they are not added to the systematic budget. Excluded sector pairs were not put back. Missing comparisons were not filled with zero. The y subdivision source was not removed.
unresolved: No retained bin is still more than 1 chi-squared above its own unconstrained cosine, so another guide change would not help. The remaining high chi-squared is the histogram shape. (Q2_y_Bin_13)-(z_pT_Bin_10) 4.129 (chi2 86.718, NDF 21); (Q2_y_Bin_12)-(z_pT_Bin_24) 4.121 (chi2 61.812, NDF 15); (Q2_y_Bin_14)-(z_pT_Bin_12) 4.023 (chi2 80.464, NDF 20); (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_32) 3.904 (chi2 81.985, NDF 21). Isolated spikes that the cosine already follows: (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_26) pull 5.52 at 352 deg, fraction 0.61; (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_32) pull 8.03 at 352 deg, fraction 0.79; (Q2_y_Bin_14)-(z_pT_Bin_12) pull 6.39 at 352 deg, fraction 0.51. why_retained: Pass 2 is kept because every histogram chi-squared is at least as low as the stored fit, 30 are lower by more than 0.05, and the curves follow each sub_y_5 histogram. (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_8) is no longer pinned at B=-0.045. The nominal value was not imposed. Near-zero parameter errors that remain are a stability note, not a smaller systematic uncertainty, and fit-parameter errors were not added to the systematic.
